content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is there a way to access and modify the current date and time on [product_name] using Modbus? I managed this before with [version_no], but I couldn't achieve the same results with Modbus. I would like a solution that works for both protocols. Thanks in advance for any assistance.
Do you mean transferring the current date and time from the [product_name] to Modbus?

Exactly! Just to update, I've resolved the problem on my own. I read and wrote the 6 bytes from the VM area at offset 985 using Modbus and it works just as it does with [version_no]. I can now access and modify the current date and time on the [product_name] with both [version_no] and Modbus. Thank you anyway!

analysis.insight_summary: The user initially faced issues with accessing and modifying the date and time on a [product_name] device via Modbus, a feature previously implemented with [version_no]. After troubleshooting, the user found that reading and writing a specific memory area via Modbus provided the same results as with [version_no], and the issue was solved independently.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking to seamlessly access and update the current date and time of a [product_name] device using both [version_no] and Modbus protocols.
